subject: Use literal stretched distance for approaching-new-enemy range
description: An AttackingApproachingNewEnemy arrival took the swordfight arm because Rust compared raw planning-map X/Y, while Original calls SquareDistance on the actors' literal positions, stretching world Y and including elevation before the authored sword-range-plus-ten threshold. The close gate now requires identity-matched live geometry and uses Original's stretched 3D distance, while the re-approach GoNear destination remains the target's planning position. Focused stretched-Y, elevation, live-position, and missing-snapshot controls pass. The frame-113 frontier clears and advances to an independent frame-117 mismatch.
